opening.argument: The presentation is a branded institutional conference focused on Coinbase’s business and platform positioning. It describes Coinbase as “absolutely the dominant institutional platform in the world” and asks the audience to “please, please choose Coinbase as your partner,” which is ordinary corporate promotion directed toward business relationships. The discussion of institutional capital, Bitcoin ownership, custody, and moving money through multiple accounts concerns institutional platform functions and business payments, not a giveaway or a promised individual outcome. The material is presented as information about Coinbase’s services and partnerships, rather than investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold an asset.

citations.quote: Coinbase is absolutely the dominant institutional platform in the world
please, please choose Coinbase as your partner
You can move money 24-7 through a number of different accounts
custody is the core of our flywheel
